capabilities: apply Chinese typography, fonts and paper backgrounds per note or via auto rules
run one-click formatting on pasted text with previews and undo
enable typewriter mode, focus mode, line highlight and Chinese punctuation checks
preview, copy and export to TXT, Markdown, DOCX or long-image PNG
import .ttf/.otf/.woff font files for consistent rendering across devices
disambiguation: Not a novel project manager; it explicitly excludes character management, worldbuilding, outlines and timelines, covering only typography, text cleanup and delivery.
extras: The manifest carries a 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice; manual installation via GitHub Release zip is documented, and a detailed install guide is referenced in a separate 安装指南.txt file.
problem: Obsidian's default display and text handling are not tuned for long-form Chinese writing, and text pasted from web pages or chat apps arrives with messy spacing, blank lines and punctuation.
summary: Chinese long-form writing mode that adds selectable typography, paper themes, one-click text cleanup, writing aids, and TXT/Markdown/DOCX/PNG export.
